rows.grounds: compound of tantra and ukta, neuter accusative singular
compound of vajra and rūpin, instrumental singular masculine

items.question: What does the verse claim one accomplishes by that vajra-formed means?
items.inference: By that vajra-formed means one should accomplish all tantra-declared things.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tena is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: By that, one should accomplish all that is declared in the tantra, by means of the vajra-formed power.
